newsitem.title: DUBAI: World Bank to extend up to $600 mln to Iran -IRNA.
newsitem.headline: World Bank to extend up to $600 mln to Iran -IRNA.

text.p: The World Bank will extend up to $600 million in credit facilities to Iran for five development projects in the next 25 years, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported on Tuesday.

It said Rene Costa, World Bank adviser for Middle East and North Africa development plans, said the projects included sewage networks and flood-prevention systems, irrigation and electricity generation and the expansion of 600 clinics in remote parts of Iran.
Costa said the World Bank and the United Nations Development Programme were currently involved in a project to cut air pollution in Tehran.
